customlist.description: Lifecycle of a trader-flagged bundle split on a Sales Order line. Pending = the trader has flagged the split and the source bundle is held; nothing exists in inventory yet. In progress = the server has CLAIMED the line and is posting the inventory adjustment; a line left here means a split started and did not finish, so the wood may already have moved and it must be looked at by hand rather than run again. Done = the warehouse keyed the actual quantities and the server has created the child lot, trued up the Sales Order line and released the remainder.
customlist.name: MGSL Split Status
